_meta.quantity: absolute monthly period mean (obs_value baseline, proj_value futures); not change
_meta.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of valid 1 km climate cells intersecting the region polygon; common support = cells valid in all three periods for that metric and month

CWBPT.basis: ensemble-mean cells, all months and periods, quantiles 0.005-0.995 rounded outward to 10; values beyond are drawn at the end colour

Prec_sum.basis: ensemble-mean cells, all months and periods, quantiles 0.005-0.995 rounded outward to 10; values beyond are drawn at the end colour

Tmax_mean.basis: ensemble-mean cells, all months and periods, quantiles 0.005-0.995 rounded outward to 1; values beyond are drawn at the end colour
